output.content: I was digging through the configuration files for the current model update cycle while preparing the next retraining run. The training pipeline is set up to start automatically based on the weekly schedule, but the active trigger for this specific cycle is not configured. The system is currently relying on a manual start command to kick off the evaluation process. There are no pending changes to the trigger logic in the queue, and the previous cycle followed the same pattern. The logs confirm the manual initiation steps are being logged as expected. It seems the evaluation setup works this way today, with the manual step being the standard part of the nightly routine for now.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational state of the pipeline without expressing any wishes, refusals, or trade-offs, and the manual step is presented as the established standard rather than a boundary or driver.
